tab.note: Per existing menu strings (選取下一個分頁).

view.note: The View menu itself is 檢視; use 檢視畫面 when referring to an open server view as a countable noun.

popout window.note: pop out (verb) → 彈出, matching Calls zh_Hant.

system tray.note: Per existing strings (最小化到系統匣).

badge.note: Follows Apple zh-TW notification-badge terminology; 未讀標記 for 'unread badge'.

flash.note: Per existing: 在收到新訊息時閃爍工作列圖示.

start app on login.target: 在登入時啟動應用程式
start app on login.note: Launch app minimized → 以最小化模式啟動應用程式 (existing).

authentication secret.note: Not yet translated; 密鑰 for 'secret' distinguishes it from 密碼 (password) and 金鑰 (key).

dark mode.note: Existing menu string uses 暗色模式; OS-level convention is 深色模式 — keep 暗色模式 for consistency.

zoom.note: Zoom In → 放大, Zoom Out → 縮小 (existing: 放大畫面/縮小畫面).

clear data.note: Clear All Data → 清除所有資料; Clear Cache and Reload → 清除快取並重新載入 (existing).
